answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with independent service receipts: every claimed job must attach receipts from two unrelated external services, like a voyage that needs stamps from both a glacier outpost and a vine-covered waystation. Receipts are bound to one identity and one timestamp, so a farm reusing one receipt across thousands of fakes is caught by duplicate IDs, while buying separate accounts at each provider for every fake costs real subscriptions per identity. One honest agent already makes those calls for real work, so proving them costs almost nothing extra.
